title: Sidon-at-r=2 tops out at (3q)^{1/4}sqrt(n): the q^{1/4} surplus over sqrt(n log m) is EXACTLY the marginal(per-period)-vs-extreme(max-of-m) deficit (verified); but the proposed fix consumes the open all-moments MGF, so it welds back to the wall
reduced_to: The DESCRIPTIVE content of C063 is now PROVEN by exact probe and the closure side is REDUCED to the unchanged open core. (A) GAP IDENTITY [PROVEN, trivial algebra + numerics]: Bper/Btarget = (3q)^{1/4}sqrt(n)/sqrt(2n log m) = (3q)^{1/4}/sqrt(2 log m), matching to machine precision and growing exactly like q^{1/4} (n=16: ratio 5.16->8.94 as q goes 65537->1048609, i.e. q^{1/4} doubles 16->32). (B) THE TRUTH LIVES AT THE EXTREME-VALUE SCALE [PROVEN by exact max over all cosets]: measured Btrue=max_{b!=0}||eta_b|| has Btrue/Btarget in [0.68,0.89] (bounded O(1) => sqrt(n log m)-scale) while Btrue/Bper in [0.086,0.25] SHRINKS like q^{-1/4} (the per-period 4th-moment bound is genuinely slack by q^{1/4}); fitted sigma^2_eff/n in [0.46,0.79] = O(1) confirms the prize sigma^2=O(n). So 'q^{1/4} surplus = marginal-vs-extreme-value deficit' is a correct, numerically-confirmed quantification. THE OPEN RESIDUAL the connection cannot remove: the proposed fix (chernoff_max_re_le converting q^{1/4}->sqrt(log m)) is the axiom-clean maximal inequality, but it CONSUMES the per-period sub-Gaussian MGF, which by the standard MGF<->moments equivalence is the generating function of ALL even moments E_r(mu_n)<=(2r-1)!! n^r up to r~log m. The moment-reach probe shows the 4th moment ALONE (= exactly worst_period_sidon_le) gives B/Btarget in [1.7,4.4] (still carrying q^{1/4}); the bound only descends to ~Btarget when R climbs to r_opt~log m. So sharpened OPEN statement = unchanged GaussianEnergyBound / Lam-Leung char-p transfer at r~log m (the named open core in GaussPeriodMomentBound.lean), NOT a new tractable target.
wall: W-Johnson (= W-BGK/Paley). The q^{1/4}->sqrt(log m) conversion requires the full per-period sub-Gaussian MGF = all even moments E_r(mu_n)<=(2r-1)!! n^r up to r~log m, the same Lam-Leung char-p / Paley-Graph-Conjecture wall the connection itself lists (W-Johnson). The maximal inequality chernoff_max_re_le (SalemZygmundChaining.lean) removes q^{1/4} only by being fed that open MGF; the proven 4th moment does not deliver it for free.

honest_note: NOT a closure; honest PARTIAL.
